description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of experts and the normalized gate average value for different tasks. The x-axis is labeled "Experts" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 64, with tick labels at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Normalized Gate Average Value" and has a linear scale from 0 to 0.20, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The “Intent” line is red and solid, starting at approximately 0.17 at an expert value of 1 and decreasing to approximately 0.03 at an expert value of 64. The “Summary” line is blue and solid, beginning at around 0.15 at an expert value of 1 and declining to approximately 0.02 at an expert value of 64. The "Law" line is yellow and solid, starting at around 0.10 at an expert value of 1 and decreasing to approximately 0.02 at an expert value of 64. The “Translation” line is purple and solid, initiating at approximately 0.13 at an expert value of 1 and falling to around 0.03 at an expert value of 64. The “Math” line is green and solid, starting at approximately 0.06 at an expert value of 1 and declining to approximately 0.02 at an expert value of 64. The “Code” line is grey and solid, starting at approximately 0.04 at an expert value of 1 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at an expert value of 64. Finally, the “Uniform” line is black and dashed, remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.00 along the entire x-axis. Shaded areas surrounding the solid lines indicate variance across layers.
